summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term indices, evidenced by massive $1B+ call accumulations in SPX 6000C (exp 2026) and heavy BuyCall dominance in NVDA (P/C 0.10) and AMD (P/C 0.13). Significant directional conviction is visible in the persistent, multi-day accumulation of SPX 6000C and SPXW 8120C/8130C strikes, totaling billions in premium over the last 3-4 sessions. While semiconductor names like MU and NVDA show massive premium, the extreme low Put/Call ratios in NVDA and AMD suggest a heavy "buy the dip" sentiment or massive upside hedging. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the SPX/NDX, but monitor the SNDK P/C ratio (1.09) and MU 850P ($170.8M) for signs of localized hedging or rotation into defensive positions.
